sources.title: City of Mexico Beach FY26-27 Budget (scanned, posted Oct 2026 on the City Financial Reports page). Department expense sheets list each salaried position and the percent charged to each department. Values read from page images
City of Mexico Beach FY25-26 Budget (scanned)

positions.title: Fire Chief
positions.notes: Charged 100% to Fire Rescue. Individual salary is not shown; the department's 10 positions total $485,555 in FY2027 salaries (FY2026 budget $600,321).

positions.title: Firefighter
positions.notes: Nine 'Fire Ftr. - 100%' lines. Department salaries total $485,555 for the Fire Chief and 9 firefighters (average about $48,556 across all 10). Plus $15,000 overtime and $5,000 volunteer pay.

positions.title: Code Officer
positions.notes: Sole position in Code Enforcement (100%). FY2027 salaries line $54,621; FY2026 rate shown as $51,040.08.

positions.title: Law enforcement (Bay County Sheriff's Office contract)
positions.notes: Mexico Beach contracts with the Bay County Sheriff's Office. The FY2027 Police line is $1,369,578. Deputies are not city employees.

positions.title: City Administrator
positions.notes: Charged 70% City Administrator, 15% Water, 15% Sewer. Individual salary is not itemized.

positions.title: City Clerk
positions.notes: Charged 100% to City Clerk. The department's salary line ($95,170) also carries 25% of the Executive Assistant.

positions.title: Executive Assistant
positions.department: City Administrator / City Clerk / General Government

positions.title: Public Works Director
positions.notes: Charged 20% General Maintenance, 10% Roads & Streets, 20% Canal, 30% Vehicle Maintenance, 10% Parks, 10% Sanitation.

positions.title: Public Works Supervisor
positions.notes: Same split as the Public Works Director.

leaders.name: Mell Smigielski
leaders.title: City Administrator
leaders.notes: Salary not itemized. 70% of it plus 25% of the Executive Assistant's salary equals $107,359 in the City Administrator department; the other 30% is charged to Water and Sewer.

leaders.name: Tammy Brunson
leaders.title: City Clerk
leaders.notes: The City Clerk department salary line of $95,170 is 100% of the clerk plus 25% of the Executive Assistant
